note: Exploratory reference sites, not the official NASA Space Apps 2026 candidate-site catalogue. Two kinds: south-polar literature reference points, and published mission landing sites (Apollo, CLPS, other national programmes) built by tools/build_reference_sites.py from data/reference/landing_sites_standin.csv with one cited source per coordinate. A 'target_region_centre' position is the centre of a named feature, not a landing point.

sites.name: Malapert Massif reference point
sites.source_record: NASA Science image page: Malapert region (85.99 S, 357.07 E). Reference point only; not a defined landing ellipse.

sites.name: Shackleton crater reference point
sites.source_record: Peer-reviewed open-access study reports Shackleton at approximately 89.4 S, 129.4 E. Crater reference point, not landing ellipse.

sites.source_record: Peer-reviewed open-access study reports de Gerlache at approximately 88.5 S, 87.1 W (272.9 E). Crater reference point, not landing ellipse.

sites.name: LOLA Site 001 reference point (Connecting Ridge region)
sites.source_record: Peer-reviewed Planetary Science Journal paper identifies Site 001 at 222.69 E, 89.45 S in the Shackleton/Connecting Ridge region. This point must not be treated as an exact official challenge site boundary.

sites.name: LOLA Site 004 reference point (Shackleton region)
